text: You see the water supply to Shady Sands. This is too little water to supply your vault.
source_text: You see the water supply to Shady Sands. This is too little water to supply your vault.

text: You have no reason to climb down the well, but perhaps the rope will be useful climbing down holes.
source_text: You have no reason to climb down the well, but perhaps the rope will be useful climbing down holes.

text: You learn nothing more from the well.
source_text: You learn nothing more from the well.

text: You make a wish as you hear the bottle cap splash into the water.
source_text: You make a wish as you hear the bottle cap splash into the water.

text: 你看到沙荫镇的水源。对于你的避难所而言真是杯水车薪。
source_text: 你看到沙荫镇的水源。对于你的避难所而言真是杯水车薪。

text: 你没有办法爬进这口井，也许一条绳子可以让你下到里面去。
source_text: 你没有办法爬进这口井，也许一条绳子可以让你下到里面去。

text: 你没法从这口井学习到新的东西。
source_text: 你没法从这口井学习到新的东西。

text: 在这瓶盖掉入井水中时你许了个愿。
